gen-dafont-good-times-general-sans: Chunky, cable-thick lowercase gives Good Times a commanding geometric stance, with only mild thick-thin shifts in its curves. General Sans glides below, one pen tip, a sans that fills the line.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-fauna-one: Dignified and literary, Fauna One keeps its middle band tall and its ascenders shallow, with a generous opening into the e. Good Times supplies the commanding punch, the serif the quiet manners.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, with wide mouths on its curves. Good Times adds a commanding geometric build with moderate contrast, giving the text below something sturdy to lean on.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is traditional and refined, with a high-waisted lowercase. Good Times handles the commanding geometric statement, while the serif gets on with wide-set s terminals and careful, quiet detail.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-kadwa: Classic and editorial, Kadwa keeps its curves open-ended and its x-height larger than usual beneath Good Times. Commanding weight up top, softened by tiny, gentle steps in each stroke.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-noticia-text: Good Times lays down a commanding geometric line, its curves shifting weight in modest, readable steps. Noticia Text then takes over with big visible entrances into each curve and lowercase bodies that fill the letter height.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-piazzolla: Good Times pulls its verticals a touch heavier than its horizontals, giving the heading a commanding geometric lean. Piazzolla keeps text feeling authoritative, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals, paragraph after paragraph.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-pridi: Pridi stands its small letters up proud, almost capital-sized, with generous space between curve ends and the stem. Good Times makes the statement, no razor-fine hairlines; Pridi does the refined talking.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-scope-one: Scope One has a big x-height and stubby ascenders and descenders, so its counters spill out into the surrounding space. And line after line it stays traditional and refined, a restrained foil to Good Times.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-slabo-13px: Cable-thick lowercase and a clear-gapped e make Good Times commanding, with bowls that thin gracefully but never sharply. But Slabo 13px takes the bookish, dignified side, its serif rounds clearly open.
